name: crispr_pipeline
title: CRISPR pipeline outputs (machine-readable bundle, per dataset)
description: Machine-readable bundle of the IGVF CRISPR FG pipeline's terminal outputs for each production dataset. Three top-level folders are mirrored as-is from the canonical pipeline run on GCS to Synapse: pipeline_dashboard/, pipeline_info/, pipeline_outputs/. The bundle is large (~60 GB per dataset, dominated by inference_mudata.h5mu); only Synapse has the full bundle, the local repo only carries pointers and READMEs.

directories.description: Primary QC outputs used in slides. Contains an interactive dashboard, the final MuData, and per-element QC tables.

contents.name: dashboard.html
contents.description: Interactive HTML dashboard summarizing the run.

contents.name: inference_mudata.h5mu
contents.description: Final inference MuData. Same content as pipeline_outputs/inference_mudata.h5mu (duplicated for dashboard convenience).

contents.name: additional_qc/
contents.description: Per-gene / per-guide / per-intended-target / trans QC tables.

contents.name: evaluation_output/
contents.description: Pipeline's built-in evaluation outputs (bedgraph/bedpe for cis/trans perturbo and sceptre).

contents.name: figures/
contents.description: Pre-generated plots (knee plot, scatter, violin, evaluation barplots, precision-recall, volcano).

contents.name: guide_seqSpec_plots/
contents.description: Per-sample guide seqspec position plots and HitRatio scoring.

directories.description: Pipeline configuration captured at run time. Tiny but critical for reproducibility.

contents.name: params_<timestamp>.json
contents.description: Resolved Nextflow params at run start (one JSON per launch attempt).

contents.name: nf_core_pipeline_software_versions.yml
contents.description: Software versions for every container/tool used in the run.

directories.description: Final per-element / per-guide inference outputs from perturbo and sceptre, plus the canonical inference_mudata.h5mu.

contents.name: perturbo_cis_per_element_output.tsv.gz
contents.description: perturbo cis inference results, per (element, gene) pair.

contents.name: perturbo_cis_per_guide_output.tsv.gz
contents.description: perturbo cis inference results, per (guide, gene) pair.

contents.name: perturbo_trans_per_element_output.tsv.gz
contents.description: perturbo trans inference results, per (element, gene) pair.

contents.name: perturbo_trans_per_guide_output.tsv.gz
contents.description: perturbo trans inference results, per (guide, gene) pair.

source_locations.per_dataset: See `experimental_metadata.tsv` -> gcs_output_path for each dataset's canonical run prefix.
source_locations.note: GCS is the canonical source for the jamboree. Intermediate artifacts may also exist on local HPC scratch but should not be used.

mirroring.approach: For each dataset: list the three GCS prefixes, stream-download to a temp dir, upload to Synapse under 2026_UTSW/datasets/<dataset_id>/crispr_pipeline/, then clean up. Resulting Synapse folder/file IDs are recorded in synapse_paths.tsv (column `crispr_pipeline`).

downstream_human_readable_outputs.plan: A cross-dataset summary TSV (read counts, mapping rates, cell counts, n significant targets) and per-dataset summary plots will be derived from these bundles in a follow-up step. See docs/analysis/CRISPR_PIPELINE_OUTPUTS.md for the metric extraction TODO.
